svg.aria-label: Claude’s play loop: go_to keycards, then go_to the next room, attacking the closest monsters first if they block the way. In each room, look, then attack the urgent record first; each kill makes Connect AI read that record again, live. Repeat until the room is clear. Sometimes, after a few kills, Claude makes one Connect AI check in another app. When no rooms are left, go_to the vault, where Connect AI Data Security refuses the red door, and write the summary. Every look, go_to and attack costs 1 of 100 moves; Connect AI calls cost none.

g.text: pick up a keycard per door
